name: Tokyo → Osaka → Hokkaido
tagline: Always together: one short Hakone–Fuji car trip from Kawasaki to Mishima, an Osaka hotel with a ryokan night in Nara Park, and 4 nights in Hokkaido.
summary: 3 nights in Shinjuku with a full anime day and a Girls Band Cry day in Kawasaki, where Pegasis picks up a car for Yokohama Chinatown, Daikoku, the Turnpike and Fuji. One Fuji-view villa night, then the car goes back at Mishima and a direct Kodama takes you to Osaka for Nara, Suzuka, Kyoto, Den Den Town, Liberty Walk and the Toyota Automobile Museum, with one ryokan night inside Nara Park and a Matsusaka beef dinner. A JAL flight to Hokkaido: 3 nights in Kutchan for skiing (Pegasis teaches Aoki) and the Rusutsu drift course, 1 night in Sapporo. You do everything together, every meal has a named place, and every train and bus has its departure time. Pegasis brings his own winter clothes; ski wear is rented at Hirafu; gloves and goggles are bought in Kutchan.

who.pegasis: In: 23 of 25 WANTs. Daikoku (you drive, no guide) + Tatsumi, Turnpike, Taikanzan, Otome Pass, Gotemba outlets (plain shopping, 45 min), TMG view, airport bus instead of N'EX, Omoide/Golden Gai, Radio Kaikan, Maidreamin, Ikebukuro goods route, Nakano, SHELTER with a live show, Nara hill fire, Suzuka EV kart and the Tokaido car road (as Hakone–Fuji by car + Suzuka + Nagoya), Niseko Grand Hirafu, Rusutsu drift (30-min self-drive course at 15:00), GARAKU, Moiwa, Daruma. Out: Asahiyama penguins (5 h of travel), Onuma (2 h south of Niseko, a whole extra day). Your maybes in: Chureito, Lake Kawaguchi, Shibuya Sky, the Kawasaki GBC walk. Because you travel together, you now also join some short stops you marked not interested: Suga stairs (15 min), Nissan Crossing (20 min), Enoshima (1 h), Fuji Motorsports Museum (1 h), Toyota museum (1 h 20), Fushimi Inari and Kinkakuji (a calm morning, not at dawn). Nijo Market is out (no split on the last day).
who.aoki: In: about 43 of 49 WANTs. Omoide/Golden Gai, Suga stairs, Tokyo Station dome and Hachiko (GBC Tokyo), Nissan Crossing, TMG, Radio Kaikan, ZEST, Nakano and used goods, Ikebukuro, Shimokita and a SHELTER live show, Shibuya Sky before 15:00 + Nintendo/Pokémon, the Kawasaki GBC stamp walk, Daikoku + Tatsumi, Enoshima + Slam Dunk crossing, Hakone as Tokyo-3, Fuji Motorsports Museum, Lake Kawaguchi, Hanz villa, Yuru Camp Motosu, Nara fire, Suzuka, Toyota museum, and your maybe the Toyota Automobile Museum (an extra day from Osaka), Fushimi Inari + Kinkakuji (not at dawn, so Pegasis can join), no Sabbat places (they are only for looking, so they are out), Namba food, Den Den Town, Liberty Walk, Donki coupon, one and a half ski days at Niseko on the beginner area (Pegasis teaches you, no paid lesson), Rusutsu drift (back seat), Moiwa, Daruma. You also join Pegasis's Taikanzan and Gotemba outlets (short stops you marked not interested). Yokohama Chinatown (dinner before Daikoku). Out: Cup Noodles Museum (it closes at 18:00, too early for the Kawasaki day), GBC Yako stamps, Fujiten ski (Niseko instead), the paid maid-café tour (two maid cafés instead), Cape Kamui (path closed in winter), Aokana/Goto (off route), Toyota Kaikan (closed Sundays). Uji is skipped because you marked it not interested.

tips: Golden Gai (新宿ゴールデン街) is 8 min east: one drink there before Don Quijote.
Banpaiya standing bar: drinks from about ¥290.

places.ja: ドン・キホーテ 新宿歌舞伎町店

info.label: Small items

Buy a 60–70 L suitcase with 4 wheels: it must hold everything Pegasis buys until Feb 2.

places.ja: 東京都庁 展望室

tips: Go in the morning: Fuji is clearest before noon in winter.

Do not follow street touts for maid cafés.

tips: Route: Animate → Stellaworth (2F, across the road) → Surugaya 1F + Lashinbang 3F → K-BOOKS buildings toward Sunshine City.
Eat lunch in the Sunshine 60-dori side streets.

places.ja: 中野ブロードウェイ
places.blurb: A 1960s shopping building. Floors 2 to 4 are full of used figures, manga and toys, with many Mandarake shops.
tips: Go after 13:00: many small shops open late.

places.ja: 下北沢（ぼっち・ざ・ろっく！聖地）

tips: You arrive after dark: the shopping streets are lit and busy until about 20:00.
Do not photograph private houses.

places.ja: 下北沢SHELTER

Standing only. Enter by the number on your ticket.
When you buy the ticket, note the OPEN time and end the Shimokitazawa walk 15 min before it.

places.blurb: An open-air roof deck 230 m above the Shibuya Scramble. A morning slot is the cheap web price and has the clearest Fuji view.

info.value: Web tickets open about 2 weeks ahead (about Jan 7)

info.label: Nearby
info.value: Shibuya PARCO 6F: Nintendo TOKYO and Pokémon Center, 8 min walk

tips: The roof closes in strong wind or rain. Check in the morning.
After: Hachiko statue and Spain-zaka (Girls Band Cry ep 3) are 5 min on foot.

places.blurb: Girls Band Cry: the open square where the band plays on the street. Start the GBC stamp tour here.
tips: Island Mura Guitars closed on Sep 23, 2026: check the new stamp list in January 2027.

places.blurb: The car pickup: a real Toyota shop on Shinkawa-dori, 5–8 min on foot from Kawasaki Station east side, that allows one-way returns outside the prefecture. The shop inside MUZA Kawasaki (west exit) does NOT allow one-way returns.

info.label: Address

info.label: Rent
info.value: Thu Jan 21 16:45 → Sat Jan 23 10:35 at Mishima

Both drivers show licence + passport; extra driver is free.

Food court and konbini inside: dinner here.

places.ja: 辰巳第一PA（上り）
places.blurb: A small parking area with the Tokyo skyline behind the parked cars. A short second car-meet stop on the way back.
tips: Optional: Umihotaru island in the bay adds about 1 h and a ¥3,140 toll.

places.ja: 江島神社・片瀬江ノ島駅

places.ja: 大観山（アネスト岩田ターンパイク箱根）
places.blurb: The Hakone Turnpike (14 km of smooth curves from Odawara) ends here at 1,011 m, with Mt Fuji over Lake Ashi.

Eat lunch at the Sky Lounge at the top.

places.ja: 乙女峠
places.blurb: The Route 138 pass between Sengokuhara and Gotemba, with a big Fuji view from the Fujimi-chaya side.
tips: Stop only in the marked lay-by, not on the road.

places.ja: 富士モータースポーツミュージアム
places.blurb: A museum at the gate of Fuji Speedway with about 100 years of race cars from Toyota, Nissan, Honda and others.
tips: 20 min by car to the Gotemba outlets.

places.ja: 御殿場プレミアム・アウトレット
places.blurb: A large outlet mall with Mt Fuji behind the shops. A plain shopping stop for Pegasis.
tips: Fuji view from the Hill Side bridge.
45 minutes only: you must be over Kagosaka Pass before dark.

places.ja: 河口湖 大石公園
places.blurb: Mt Fuji straight across the lake. At sunset the snow on Fuji turns pink.
tips: Very cold after sunset; wear the ski jacket.

places.ja: HANZ OUTDOOR RESORT 河口湖

info.label: Access

tips: The park is closed Jan 26–29; Jan 24 is one of 4 open days.
Buy the kart slot on Asoview on Dec 1, 2026, for about 12:30.

places.en: Toyota Commemorative Museum of Industry and Technology
places.ja: トヨタ産業技術記念館
places.blurb: Toyota's first red-brick loom factory: looms, then cars built step by step with robot demos.
tips: Open on Sunday; Toyota Kaikan in Toyota City is closed on Sundays.

places.ja: 伏見稲荷大社
places.blurb: Thousands of red torii gates up the hill. At 7:00 the tunnels are almost empty.

info.label: From Namba
info.value: Keihan line from Yodoyabashi, about 45 min

tips: Walk to the Yotsutsuji viewpoint (about 40 min up) and back.

places.ja: 金閣寺
places.blurb: The gold pavilion. If snow fell in the night, it has a white roof: only 1–3 mornings a winter.
tips: Be at the gate at 9:00, before the tour buses.

places.ja: 黒門市場
places.blurb: A covered market street: grilled scallops, wagyu skewers, fruit and cooked seafood.
tips: Aoki: choose grilled and cooked stalls, not raw.

places.ja: 日本橋でんでんタウン・オタロード
places.blurb: Osaka's Akihabara: electronics on Sakaisuji and the side street Otaroad full of figure, game and doujin shops.
tips: Animate and Melonbooks are 2 min apart.

places.ja: めいどりーみん 大阪日本橋オタロード店
places.blurb: The Osaka shop of the same maid café chain, on Otaroad. A break between shops.
tips: For a quieter one, CCOちゃ opens 15:00 on weekdays.

places.ja: JDM PARK / LB DRIVE-IN
places.romaji: Jē Dī Emu Pāku / Eru Bī Doraibu In
places.blurb: Liberty Walk's wide-body cars, goods shop and a Sanuki udon shop, opened in 2025.

info.label: Hours
info.value: Official site 11:00–21:00 daily; Instagram 11:00–19:00, closed Thu

tips: Wednesday is open on both sources; do not go on Thursday.
Taxis at Izumi-Sunagawa are not certain: ask the shop to call one, or walk the 1.7 km (about 22 min).

places.ja: 戎橋
places.blurb: The Glico sign and the canal lights. Takoyaki and okonomiyaki all along Dotonbori.
tips: Busy until late; keep bags in front.

places.ja: 大阪国際空港（伊丹）
places.blurb: The city airport for domestic flights. Small and fast; JAL includes a 20 kg bag.

info.label: Flight
info.value: JAL (J-Air) 10:50 → New Chitose 12:35, Fri Jan 29, ¥16,330 incl. 20 kg bag (Google Flights, Sep 26, 2026)

info.label: Bus
info.value: Osaka Airport Limousine from Namba-ekimae (N1) 08:40 / 09:00 → Itami North Terminal (JAL) 09:10 / 09:30, ¥730; from OCAT (JR Namba) 08:50 / 09:10

tips: Bag drop closes 20 min before departure.

places.ja: 新千歳空港
places.blurb: Hokkaido's main airport. Rental car counters send a free shuttle to their lots.

info.label: Rental cars
info.value: Counters in arrivals, free shuttle to the shops

info.label: Tax-free
info.value: From Nov 2026 tax-free is a refund at departure: keep receipts and goods for the customs check

tips: Snow delays are common: keep phone numbers of the hotel and the car shop.

places.en: Toyota Rent a Car New Chitose Airport Poplar
places.ja: トヨタレンタカー 新千歳空港ポプラ店
places.blurb: Check in at the rental counter in the arrivals hall, then a free 9-min shuttle to the shop. Studless tyres are standard in Hokkaido.

info.label: Rent
info.value: Fri Jan 29 13:40 → Mon Feb 1 about 12:45, one way to Sapporo-ekimae

info.label: Car
info.value: Ask for 4WD (e.g. Corolla Cross / Yaris Cross 4WD)

info.label: One-way
info.value: Allowed inside Hokkaido; fee not checked (small, check when you book)

tips: Book now (6 months ahead): late-January 4WD cars sell out.
Give your flight number when you book: the shuttle needs it.
Skis fit inside a small SUV; the ski gear is rented at Hirafu anyway.

places.ja: ステイリゾートニセコ
places.blurb: A small self check-in hotel in Kutchan town, 5 min on foot from JR Kutchan Station. Every room has a mini kitchen; 15 min by car to Grand Hirafu, 50 min to Rusutsu.

info.label: Room
info.value: Twin (bunk bed) with bath and toilet, mini kitchen, non-smoking (the whole hotel is non-smoking)

info.label: Price
info.value: ¥81,360 per room for 3 nights, room only = ≈ ¥40,700 per person (Rakuten, Sep 26, 2026; 9 rooms left)

info.label: Address
info.value: Kita 1-jo Nishi 2-20-5, Kutchan (pin: nearest block point)

info.label: Parking
info.value: Free car park 200 m away (map at the front)

tips: Replaces Hotel Three M: on Sep 26, 2026 it had only smoking twins left for these nights.
No staff at night: phone numbers are at the check-in machine.
The twin has a bunk bed; the sister hotel STAY LIVING NISEKO (Kita 2-jo Nishi 1) has the same rooms and price.

places.ja: セイコーマート 倶知安
places.blurb: Hokkaido's own konbini, with a Hot Chef counter that cooks katsudon and fried chicken in the shop.
tips: Buy the next breakfast here too: the hotel has no breakfast, but the room has a mini kitchen.

places.en: Grand Hirafu .Base (rental shop and ski school desk)
places.ja: グラン・ヒラフ .Base（レンタル・スクール）
places.blurb: The official rental shop at the Ace Gondola base. Rent skis, boots, poles, helmet and the ski jacket and pants here, and leave them in the daily storage overnight. Gloves and goggles you buy in Kutchan.

info.label: Ski wear
info.value: Jacket + pants ¥16,200 for 2 days (without goggles, gloves, beanie)

info.label: Your set, 2 days
info.value: ¥36,900 per person, ¥33,210 with the 10% early code (2026-27 price list)

tips: Reserve online before Oct 31, 2026 with code TGHRental109 (10% off, shown on en.grand-hirafu.jp/snow/rentals).
Daily storage: leave the gear at the shop between the two ski days.

places.ja: ニセコ東急 グラン・ヒラフ
places.blurb: The biggest Niseko slope, with light powder and Mt Yotei across the valley. Pegasis teaches Aoki on the beginner area on both days.

info.label: Lift ticket 2026–27 (Peak season, Dec 24 – Feb 28)
info.value: Hirafu & Hanazono 1 day ¥11,800 online (¥12,500 at the counter); afternoon 4 h ¥8,400 online (¥8,900) (official ticket page; online sales not open yet)

info.label: Beginner area
info.value: Ace Family area (Ace Family lift, own ticket counter at its base)

info.label: Lesson
info.value: None: Pegasis teaches Aoki (a paid group lesson is in Japanese only)

tips: Pegasis: stay on marked runs; the gates to the backcountry need avalanche gear.
Start Aoki on the flat part at the bottom of the Ace Family area: walking with skis, snowplough, stopping; ride the lift only after that.

places.ja: ルスツリゾート 雪上ドリフト
places.blurb: A closed snow course at Rusutsu with Subaru, GT-R and GR Yaris cars. You drive yourself with an instructor next to you.

info.label: Ride-along (pro drives, 4 min)
info.value: Subaru B4 ¥17,000 per person for 1–2 people; slots 8:30, 10:00, 13:00, 15:00

info.label: Booking
info.value: Prepaid, by 17:00 the day before; cancel fee 10% from booking, 50% the day before, 100% after 17:00 the day before

info.label: Reception
info.value: Rusutsu Resort activity desk (open 08:00–16:00), shuttle to the River Wood car park

tips: Email activity@rusutsu.co.jp before booking: the site asks only for a driver's licence and does not say if a 1-year licence + IDP is accepted.
Bring passport, licence and IDP; alcohol check before driving.

places.ja: スープカレー GARAKU
places.blurb: Sapporo's famous soup curry: a thin spicy soup with big chicken and grilled vegetables.
tips: Be in the queue by 11:20 on Monday.
You arrive by car: use a coin car park near Nijo Market (no parking at the shop).

places.ja: トヨタレンタカー 札幌駅前店
places.blurb: Return the Hokkaido car here, 6 min on foot from JR Sapporo Station (east side, across Soseigawa-dori).
tips: Fill the tank before you return the car.

places.ja: ホテルルートイン札幌中央
places.blurb: A good-value business hotel with a public bath and free breakfast buffet, 5 min from Susukino and Daruma.

info.label: Price
info.value: Twin with breakfast ¥19,800 per room (Rakuten, Feb 1, Sep 26, 2026)

info.label: Laundry
info.value: Coin laundry in the hotel (Route Inn standard)

tips: Book the early-bird plan by about Jan 4.

places.ja: もいわ山
places.blurb: A ropeway and mini cable car to a viewpoint above the whole of Sapporo. Go up before sunset and stay for the lights.
tips: Free shuttle bus from the streetcar stop ロープウェイ入口.

places.ja: 成吉思汗だるま 本店
places.blurb: The most famous Jingisukan (grilled lamb) shop in Sapporo, since 1954: a small counter with dome pans.
tips: Cash is safest.
Your clothes will smell of lamb: wear the old jacket.

places.en: MEGA Don Quijote Sapporo Tanukikoji (24 h)
places.ja: MEGAドン・キホーテ 札幌狸小路本店
places.blurb: Last big shop before the flights: snacks, cosmetics and gifts, tax-free. Pegasis fills the suitcase here.

info.label: Tax-free
info.value: From ¥5,000 before tax, passport; refund at the airport from Nov 2026

info.label: Also
info.value: Luggage scale and a second small bag if the suitcase is full

tips: Weigh the suitcase: most checked bags must be 23 kg or less.

places.ja: 自家製麺 杵屋麦丸 成田国際空港第1ターミナル店
places.blurb: Self-service udon made in the shop, with tempura and rice balls. In the Terminal 1 Central Building, 5F, before security.
tips: Aoki eats here while he waits for Pegasis. Both flights use Terminal 1.
Other choice on T1 4F: Tonkatsu Saboten.

places.ja: 炭火串焼 かっぺ亭 新宿思い出横丁本店
places.blurb: A charcoal yakitori bar in Omoide Yokocho with 42 seats, so two people get in easily. Cheap skewers and drinks.

info.label: Hours
info.value: Mon–Fri 16:00–23:00, Sat/Sun 12:00–23:00, no closed day (Tabelog, Sep 2026; Omoide Yokocho site)

tips: Cash is safest (the Omoide site says cash only).

places.ja: 珉亭
places.blurb: An old Chinese diner famous for pink fried rice and "ra-chan" (ramen + fried rice). 2 minutes from SHELTER.
tips: Everything is cooked: good for Aoki.
60 seats: dinner takes 30–45 min.

places.ja: 魚べい 渋谷道玄坂店
places.blurb: Touch-screen sushi: plates come on an express lane. There are cooked plates too (fried chicken, egg, noodles).
tips: Aoki can order only cooked plates.

places.ja: アネスト岩田スカイラウンジ（大観山）
places.blurb: The food court and tea lounge at the top of the Hakone Turnpike, with Fuji over Lake Ashi. Ramen, soba and curry.

info.label: Hours
info.value: Food court about 09:00–16:30; 2F tea lounge weekdays 10:00–15:30

tips: No winter closing was found, but the 2027 menu is not confirmed.

places.en: Tochuken ekiben stand, Mishima Shinkansen platform
places.ja: 桃中軒 三島駅 新幹線ホーム売店
places.blurb: The local ekiben maker since 1891, with a stand on the Shinkansen platform. The Ashitaka beef sukiyaki bento is cooked, not raw.
tips: Buy it on the platform, eat it on the Kodama (3 h, no change).

places.ja: すき家 近鉄奈良駅前店
places.blurb: A fast beef-bowl chain shop next to Kintetsu-Nara Station. Quick and warm before the cold wait at the fire.
tips: Kamameshi Shizuka is not possible: last order 16:00 on Saturday.
Festival food stalls may also be open on the field.

places.ja: アドベンチャイナ（鈴鹿サーキットパーク）
places.blurb: The ramen shop in the park, in Adventure Village. Adventure Grill (burgers) and AdvenCurry are next to it.

info.label: Menu
info.value: Spicy miso ramen ¥1,250; tanmen ¥1,300; curry ¥1,500; burger ¥1,270 (official foods page)

tips: Which park restaurants open on Jan 22–25 is not published: check the foods page in January.

places.ja: 松屋 日本橋店
places.blurb: A 24-hour gyudon chain shop, 3 min from the hotel. Hot Japanese breakfast sets for about ¥500.
tips: Order at the ticket machine by the door.
The hotel buffet costs ¥2,500 per person: here it is one fifth.

places.en: Shirakaba Sanso ramen, Hokkaido Ramen Dojo (New Chitose)
places.ja: 麺処 白樺山荘 新千歳空港店
places.blurb: Sapporo miso ramen in the Ramen Dojo, domestic terminal 3F, before security. Fast: 30 minutes is enough.
tips: Pin is the terminal point.

places.ja: ラーメン店 なかま
places.blurb: A local ramen shop 2 min from the hotel, open late.

info.label: Hours
info.value: Mon, Thu, Fri, Sat 11:00–14:00 / 17:00–24:00; Sun 11:00–24:00; closed Tue, Wed (Tabelog)

tips: Closes early if the soup runs out.

places.ja: 望羊荘
places.blurb: An old family lodge on the lower Hirafu slopes with cheap katsu curry and ramen, much cheaper than the resort restaurants.
tips: 2026–27 hours not confirmed.

places.ja: POWDERHOOD RESTAURANT & TAPROOM（ALPEN NODE）
places.blurb: Burgers and hot food in ALPEN NODE at the Ace Gondola base plaza, 5 min from .Base.

info.label: Hours
info.value: Winter daytime from about 10:30 (two sources disagree on the closing time)

tips: Backup: the food court in the Hirafu Welcome Center.

places.ja: 居酒屋 餃子の肉村
places.blurb: A small local gyoza izakaya, 5 min from the hotel. House gyoza at local prices.
tips: Opens at 18:00.

places.ja: 奈良公園
places.blurb: About 1,300 free-roaming deer on open grass between Kofukuji and Kasuga Taisha. Buy crackers and the deer bow to you for them.
tips: Show empty hands when the crackers are finished, or the deer keep pushing.
Deer bite paper: keep maps and tickets in a pocket.

places.ja: とんかつ がんこ 奈良店
places.blurb: A tonkatsu restaurant of the Ganko chain on the Higashimuki shopping street, 5 minutes from Kintetsu-Nara. Early dinner before the hill fire.

info.label: Hours
info.value: 11:00–21:15 (last order 20:45), every day (gankofood.co.jp and Google Maps, Sep 26, 2026)

tips: Come at 16:00: after 17:00 the festival crowd fills the street.

places.ja: スポーツたきぐち
places.blurb: A local ski and sports shop on the station street in Kutchan, 2 min from your hotel. Buy ski gloves and goggles here for all 3 ski days.
tips: Backup: Bigban Winter Sports in Kutchan (used gear, 10:00–19:00 every day).
Buy a beanie too if you have no warm hat: the helmet goes over it.

places.ja: 矢場とん 名古屋駅エスカ店
places.blurb: The Nagoya miso-katsu chain in the ESCA underground mall on the Shinkansen side of Nagoya Station: dinner 3 min from the platform.
tips: Table bookings are possible: useful on a Sunday evening.

places.ja: 串かつだるま 道頓堀店
places.blurb: Osaka deep-fried skewers (kushikatsu) at the famous Daruma chain. No second dip in the sauce!
tips: After dinner walk the small bars of Ura-Namba if you still have energy.

places.ja: 鵬天閣 新館
places.blurb: Yokohama Chinatown, the biggest in Japan: 500+ shops inside 4 painted gates. Dinner at Hotenkaku, known for pan-fried xiaolongbao (焼き小籠包), then a walk to the Kanteibyo temple lit up at night.
tips: The pan-fried xiaolongbao are very hot inside: bite a small hole first.

places.ja: 江戸三
places.blurb: A ryokan of small separate cottages inside Nara Park, opened in 1907. Deer walk past your door. Tatami room, yukata, and dinner served in your room.

info.label: Night
info.value: Mon Jan 25 (1 room was left on Sep 26, 2026)

info.label: Price
info.value: "Wakakusa nabe" hot-pot plan, fully cooked: ¥61,600 for 2 with dinner and breakfast (kaiseki plan ¥57,200 has sashimi) (Rakuten, Sep 26, 2026)

info.label: Access
info.value: Kintetsu-Nara 15 min on foot; Osaka-Namba about 40 min by Kintetsu

tips: Book the hot-pot plan and write "no raw fish, cooked food only" in the booking note.
Leave the suitcases at Dormy Inn Namba; bring one small bag each.

places.ja: 松阪牛焼肉M 法善寺横丁店
places.blurb: Top Matsusaka beef grilled at your table, in the old stone lane of Hozenji Yokocho next to Dotonbori. The special dinner of the trip.
tips: Book a table for 18:30 on Wed Jan 27.
Everything is cooked on the grill: fine for Aoki.

places.ja: トヨタ博物館
places.blurb: About 140 cars from all over the world, from the first petrol cars to Japanese sports cars, in Nagakute near Nagoya. A second hall shows Japanese car culture: posters, toys, models.

info.label: Hours
info.value: 9:30–17:00, last entry 16:30; closed Mondays (official site, Sep 26, 2026)

info.label: Restaurant
info.value: AVIEW, 1F of the car hall, 9:30–17:00 (food L.O. 16:00)

info.label: Access
info.value: Linimo line, Geidai-dori Station, 5 min on foot

tips: Aoki's maybe from the choice list.
Start in the main hall on 2F (world cars), then 3F (Japanese cars), then the culture hall.

places.ja: ひつまぶし名古屋備長 エスカ店
places.blurb: Nagoya's grilled eel on rice (hitsumabushi), eaten 3 ways: plain, with condiments, then with hot broth. In the ESCA mall 1 min from the Shinkansen gates. All cooked.

info.label: Where
info.value: ESCA underground mall, Shinkansen side of Nagoya Station (hitsumabushi.co.jp)

tips: Online booking on the official site: useful at dinner time.

days.title: Land in Tokyo, airport bus to Tokyo Station, late yakitori in Shinjuku
days.titleJa: 成田 → 東京駅 → 新宿（伊勢丹・思い出横丁）
days.summary: Pegasis lands first and waits at Narita Terminal 1 with an early udon; Aoki lands at 18:10 and you travel together from there. The airport bus drops you at Tokyo Station for the Girls Band Cry dome, then a late yakitori dinner in Omoide Yokocho and the suitcase for the way home at Don Quijote.
alerts: Pegasis: at immigration ask for a paper landing stamp, not the face-scan gate (the car shop checks it on Jan 21).
TMG observatory is closed today (3rd Tuesday): it is on day 2.

stops.note: Pegasis lands (WestJet, Terminal 1): immigration with a paper landing stamp, cash, Welcome Suica, eSIM.
Pegasis: early light dinner (udon), 30 min, while he waits. Aoki's breakfast and lunch are in Shanghai (CA919 has no meal).
Aoki lands 18:10 (Air China CA919, Terminal 1). Meet in the T1 arrivals lobby; Aoki buys an onigiri at the konbini.
Girls Band Cry ep 1: Nina arrives under this dome, 10 min (Aoki's pick).
Dinner: yakitori and a beer, 1 h, last order before 23:00 (Aoki's pick).
Pegasis: the suitcase for the way home (empty for now), heat packs, shoe spikes. Aoki: tourist coupon.

days.sleepNote: Night 1 of 3. Economy twin with breakfast.
notes: One plan for both: Pegasis waits at Narita (about 2.5 h) instead of going ahead alone; the station dome and Omoide are Aoki's wants, the airport bus is Pegasis's.
The Isetan half-price food is out: it closes at 20:00, before you reach Shinjuku.
If the Air China flight is late, skip the dome and take the TYO-NRT bus straight to Shinjuku (Busta Shinjuku).
Pegasis brings his own thick winter clothes: nothing to buy for the cold.
Phone data: set up a Japan data eSIM before you fly (about CA$15–25 for 10–20 GB), or buy a tourist SIM at Narita.
Buy a Welcome Suica at the airport (or use a phone Suica) for all trains and buses.
days.cost: ≈ ¥7,000 per person (bus ¥1,500, udon or onigiri, dinner) + Pegasis's suitcase ≈ ¥5,000–15,000

days.title: Anime day: Your Name stairs, Akihabara, Ikebukuro, Nakano, a live show in Shimokitazawa
days.titleJa: 須賀神社 → 都庁 → 秋葉原 → 池袋 → 中野 → 下北沢SHELTER
days.romaji: Suga Jinja → Tochō → Akihabara → Ikebukuro → Nakano → Shimokitazawa
days.summary: An early look at the Your Name stairs and the free City Hall view, then a full anime-goods day with a maid café lunch. You end at a real live show in Shimokitazawa after a cheap Chinese diner dinner.
alerts: Buy the SHELTER ticket online when the January list is out (loft-prj.co.jp, in December); note the OPEN time.
Book the Maidreamin table on the official site.

stops.note: Breakfast: free hotel buffet (07:00–09:00).
Your Name stairs, 15 min, quiet in the morning (Aoki's pick).
Free 45th-floor view; Mt Fuji on a clear morning (both of you wanted it).
10 floors of figures and cards; ZEST (Oshi no Ko) 3 min north.
Lunch with the stage show, 1 h (Pegasis's pick).
Animate main store, Surugaya, K-BOOKS, Lashinbang (used goods).
Mandarake and used goods, 1 h 10.
Bocchi places in the dark streets, 15 min.
Dinner: pink fried rice or ramen + fried rice set, 40 min.
Real live show, standing. Recent shows: OPEN 18:15–19:00, START 18:45–19:30.

Tax-free: Animate from ¥5,000 before tax; keep the passport with you. From Nov 2026 you pay the tax in the shop and get it back at the airport customs desk.
Pegasis puts the goods in the new suitcase tonight: tomorrow morning it goes to Osaka.

days.title: Shibuya Sky, Nissan Crossing, Girls Band Cry in Kawasaki, Yokohama Chinatown, then Daikoku by your own car

days.summary: Shibuya Sky in the morning and a touch-screen sushi lunch, then Nissan Crossing on the way to Kawasaki for the Girls Band Cry walk. Pegasis picks up the car at 16:45 and drives you to Yokohama Chinatown for dinner, then Daikoku and Tatsumi at night.
alerts: 09:30: hand both suitcases to the hotel front for Yamato TA-Q-BIN to Dormy Inn PREMIUM Namba (arrives Fri 22).
Pegasis: licence + IDP + passport with the landing stamp for the car at 16:45 (studless tyres confirmed in writing when you booked).
Daikoku: police now close it on some weekdays too. At 18:00 check X and the Shutoko closure site; if closed, drive straight to Tatsumi PA.

stops.note: Breakfast: free hotel buffet. 09:30: hand both suitcases to the front for Yamato to Osaka.
Web ticket entry about 10:20; Hachiko (GBC ep 3) after.
Lunch: touch-screen sushi (cooked plates for Aoki), 40 min. Then PARCO: Nintendo and Pokémon, 12:30–13:00.
Free Nissan showroom, 20 min (Aoki's pick).
Buy the GBC stamp book; Rufa Square stage.
The river steps from ep 2, in afternoon sun.
Hotcake and coffee (afternoon snack), 30 min; East Exit plaza stamp above.
Pick up the car (studless tyres, ETC). Walk past CLUB CITTA' on the way.
Dinner: pan-fried xiaolongbao, then a short walk through the gates and past Kanteibyo, 1 h (Aoki's pick).
JDM meet; Pegasis drives in (his pick).
Smaller car meet, Tokyo skyline, 15 min.

legs.label: Walk to JR Shinjuku (12 min); JR Shonan-Shinjuku Line Rapid, Shinjuku 10:00 → Shibuya 10:05; walk to Shibuya Scramble Square
